method: Target-specific guardrail. Horse-specific corrections are used only when they improve temporally held-out probability quality; otherwise the calibrated 10-year base probability is retained.

selection.horse_features: ability/history, course evidence, distance/layoff condition change, RPCI/PCI/position structure
selection.rule: Do not force a correction merely because it is richer. Reject if out-of-sample Log Loss/Brier do not improve robustly.

policy.win: 10年基礎確率を維持（馬固有補正は不採用）
policy.top2: 10年基礎確率を維持（2025改善が2026で再現せず不採用）
policy.top3: 地力・コース・条件替わり・展開の既存統合モデルを採用（2026完全OOSで改善確認済み）

notes: Top3 accepted model is the existing integrated_interpretation_v2 model, which combines popularity baseline, opponent-adjusted ability, course, condition-change and race-structure corrections.
Win/top2 retain the 10-year calibrated base until a future horse-specific model clears the same OOS guardrail.
